- **`src/bin/bat/clap_app.rs`**: new repeatable `--ignored-suffix <suffix>` CLI option (works on the command line and in `~/.config/bat/config`, since config-file args go through clap).
- **`src/bin/bat/app.rs`**: collects the values into `Config`.
- **`src/config.rs`**: added `ignored_suffixes: Vec<String>` to `Config`.

- **`src/assets.rs`**: syntax detection (`get_syntax_for_path` / `get_syntax`) uses the merged suffix list; custom suffixes are stripped iteratively (e.g. `config.json.production` → `config.json`). `--map-syntax` globs are also re-checked against stripped file names so the two options work together.
- **`src/printer.rs`**, **`src/bin/bat/main.rs`**: pass `config.ignored_suffixes` through.
